newsitem.title: USA: Health sees Q4 loss on debt extinguishment.
newsitem.headline: Health sees Q4 loss on debt extinguishment.

text.p: Health and Retirement Properties Trust on Thursday said it expects to record in this year's fourth quarter an extraordinary loss of approximately $1.5 million as a result of the early extinguishment of debt.

The debt is related to the recently completed convertible subordinated debt offerings, the firm said. The firm said that it has deposited $75.5 million into an irrevocable trust to complete an "in-substance defeasance" of its $75 million Floating Rate Senior Notes, Series A, Due 1999, and of such debt in the fourth quarter of 1996.
Earlier today, Health reported net income for the 1996 quarter was $18.5 million, or $0.28 per share as compared with net income of $16.1 million, or $0.27 per share for the 1995 quarter.
